claims.text: Team Topologies (a canonical book) names three team interaction modes: collaboration (working closely on a shared goal), X-as-a-service (using what another team provides with little discussion) and facilitating (helping another team learn).
claims.source_hint: Team Topologies (book), chapter on the three team interaction modes; no author or year in the lesson

claims.text: Per Team Topologies: collaboration suits discovering where the line between two teams' work should sit, costs both teams attention and is meant for a limited time; X-as-a-service costs little attention but needs a clear, stable offer from the provider.
claims.source_hint: Team Topologies (book), sections on collaboration and X-as-a-service; docs/team/team-structure.md @ stage-4 lines 68-69

claims.text: Per Team Topologies, facilitating is the mode an enabling team typically uses: it helps another team learn, and the learning team keeps doing its own work.
claims.source_hint: Team Topologies (book), section on the facilitating interaction mode and enabling teams

Line 65: platform and Cửa hàng are X-as-a-service via the golden path and platform-capabilities.md; one platform person facilitates SLOs, alerts and runbooks for Cửa hàng's first 2 sprints (assumption), then only X-as-a-service.

claims.text: Lines 75-79: each team publishes what it offers, how to ask (issue with the team's label; platform also accepts small pull requests directly) and an answer time of 2 working days (assumption).
Lines 81-83: 'answer' means saying it will be done and when, or why not, not finishing it, so a request to another team is a known step, not a negotiation.

ICatalog.cs lines 3-19: Product, CatalogDbContext, the repository and the Redis cache are internal and can change without callers noticing; the contract has three methods ListAsync, FindAsync, ChangePriceAsync with the shown parameters.
Đặt hàng's ordering code reads prices through ICatalog (CatalogProductPrices in DonHang.Infrastructure), outside the excerpt.

team-structure.md ends with its own review list 'Khi nào xem lại' (outside excerpt): review when two teams must edit one module in most changes of a quarter (repeating an ADR 0025 condition to reopen), and when requests often take over 2 working days to answer.
team-structure.md does not say how a change to ICatalog's shape is agreed between the two stream-aligned teams.

The situation's requests amount to collaboration (Đặt hàng with Cửa hàng on Catalog; platform with both product teams) with no end. Modes are not fixed: a pair moves to X-as-a-service once the line is clear; constant collaboration signals a misplaced line, a design question.

Collaboration fits an unknown line, fails if it never ends; X-as-a-service fits a known line, fails with an unclear or changing offer; facilitating fails when the helper does the work, and a missed end date can get a new short end; everyone-in-every-meeting rarely fits.

Choices not recorded in Đơn Hàng's files (hedged): end the move's collaboration and use the published route, gaps may be in the golden path; a shape change to ICatalog gets a short planned collaboration via an issue; repeated joint Catalog edits go to an ADR.

Possible symptoms (hedged): neither team ships without the other's calendar; a platform queue fills with deploys run for others; a collaboration's meetings continue after its goal with nothing to decide.
Per team-structure.md lines 87-93, each stream-aligned team deploys its own services through the golden path; no separate team deploys for others.
